title: How Wrong Can a Good Predictor Be? Diverging Updates with Vanishing Predictive KL
abstract: arXiv:2609.11132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate posterior prediction need not require accurate approximation of Bayesian updates. We prove that an unbounded gap between the update maps can coexist with vanishing predictive KL for every fixed finite $K\ge2$ in a stationary symmetric Gaussian HMM. Exact Bayesian mixing and an explicit deterministic radial filter act on the same $K-1$ belief coordinates. As $q\to0^+$, their separation in centered logits in the worst case grows at least linearly in the natural confidence scale $L_K(q)$, while their categorical $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\mathrm{exact}\|\mathrm{radial})$ vanishes at the same explicit witness. Along stationary HMM trajectories, the expected terminal KL between filtered posteriors also converges to zero at $H(q)=\lceil-\log(q)/c\rceil+1$. translated_title: 一个好的预测器能错到什么程度？发散的更新与消失的预测KL散度
translated_abstract: 准确的后验预测不一定需要对贝叶斯更新的准确近似。我们证明，在一个平稳对称高斯隐马尔可夫模型中，更新映射之间的无界间隙可以与预测KL散度的消失共存，且对每个固定的有限 $K\ge2$ 均成立。精确的贝叶斯混合与一个显式的确定性径向滤波器作用于相同的 $K-1$ 个信念坐标。当 $q\to0^+$ 时，它们在中心化logit上的分离在最坏情况下至少以自然置信度尺度 $L_K(q)$ 线性增长，而它们的分类散度 $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\mathrm{exact}\|\mathrm{radial})$ 在相同的显式见证点上消失。沿平稳HMM轨迹，滤波后验之间的期望终端KL也在 $H(q)=\lceil-\log(q)/c\rceil+1$ 处收敛于零。没有切换的典型块驱动两个滤波器进入共同的置信锥，其中softmax曲率抑制了它们的分歧；而单个高斯极大事件则控制自适应噪声……
tldr: 该论文证明在平稳对称高斯隐马尔可夫模型中，即使两个滤波器的预测分布KL散度趋于零（即预测表现一样好），它们对应的贝叶斯更新映射之间的差距仍可无界发散，说明良好的预测准确性并不意味着对信念更新的准确近似。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that in a stationary symmetric Gaussian HMM, the gap between Bayesian update maps can diverge unboundedly even as their predictive KL vanishes, showing that good predictive accuracy does not imply accurate approximation of the Bayesian belief update.
